Wendy’s rejects a takeover offer, scales back breakfast and still sees its stock surge

en.title: Wendy's rejects takeover offer
en.dek: Wendy's plans to proceed independently after rejecting a takeover offer, and analysts stated the company has work ahead.
facts: Wendy's rejected a takeover offer, according to MarketWatch.
Wendy's plans to go it alone, according to MarketWatch.
Analysts stated the company has "significant work ahead," according to MarketWatch.
body: MarketWatch reported that Wendy's rejected a takeover offer.
The company plans to proceed independently, according to MarketWatch.
Analysts stated the company has "significant work ahead," according to MarketWatch.
en.context: MarketWatch reported the information on 12 November 2026, detailing the corporate transaction involving Wendy's.
en.imageCaption: Josh Allen, Arvell Reese and Jahmyr Gibbs have produced thrilling performances this season. Composite: Getty Images

de.title: Wendy's lehnt Übernahmeangebot ab
de.dek: Wendy's plant, nach Ablehnung eines Übernahmeangebots, unabhängig fortzufahren; Analysten sehen noch Arbeit vor dem Unternehmen
facts: Wendy's lehnte ein Übernahmeangebot ab, laut MarketWatch
Wendy's plant, allein weiterzumachen, laut MarketWatch
Analysten sagten, das Unternehmen habe „erhebliche Arbeit vor sich“, laut MarketWatch
body: MarketWatch berichtete, dass Wendy's ein Übernahmeangebot abgelehnt hat.
Demnach plant das Unternehmen, unabhängig fortzufahren, wie MarketWatch meldete.
Analysten erklärten, das Unternehmen habe „erhebliche Arbeit vor sich“, so MarketWatch.
de.context: MarketWatch berichtete über diese Informationen am 12. November 2026 und detaillierte die Unternehmenstransaktion von Wendy's.
de.imageCaption: Josh Allen, Arvell Reese und Jahmyr Gibbs lieferten in dieser Saison spannende Leistungen. Komposit: Getty Images

fr.title: Wendy's rejette une offre de rachat
fr.dek: Wendy's prévoit de poursuivre de manière indépendante après avoir rejeté une offre de rachat, et les analystes estiment que l'entreprise a du travail à accomplir.
facts: Wendy's a rejeté une offre de rachat selon MarketWatch
Wendy's prévoit d'agir seule selon MarketWatch
Les analystes ont déclaré que l'entreprise a "un travail important à faire" selon MarketWatch
body: MarketWatch a rapporté que Wendy's a rejeté une offre de rachat.
La société prévoit de continuer de manière indépendante, selon MarketWatch.
Les analystes ont indiqué que l'entreprise a « un travail important à accomplir », d'après MarketWatch.
fr.context: MarketWatch a rapporté cette information le 12 novembre 2026, détaillant la transaction d'entreprise impliquant Wendy's.
fr.imageCaption: Josh Allen, Arvell Reese et Jahmyr Gibbs ont livré des performances palpitantes cette saison. Composition : Getty Images

es.title: Wendy's rechaza oferta de adquisición
es.dek: Wendy's planea seguir de forma independiente tras rechazar una oferta de adquisición, y analistas señalan que la compañía tiene trabajo por delante.
facts: Wendy's rechazó una oferta de adquisición, según MarketWatch
Wendy's planea actuar por su cuenta, según MarketWatch
Analistas afirmaron que la compañía tiene "trabajo importante por delante", según MarketWatch
body: MarketWatch informó que Wendy's rechazó una oferta de adquisición.
La compañía planea seguir operando de forma independiente, según MarketWatch.
Analistas indicaron que la empresa tiene "un trabajo significativo por delante", según MarketWatch.
es.context: MarketWatch informó de esta información el 12 de noviembre de 2026, detallando la transacción corporativa que involucra a Wendy's.
es.imageCaption: Josh Allen, Arvell Reese y Jahmyr Gibbs han ofrecido actuaciones emocionantes esta temporada. Compuesto: Getty Images

it.title: Wendy's rifiuta offerta di acquisizione
it.dek: Wendy's proseguirà in autonomia dopo aver respinto un'offerta di acquisizione, e gli analisti ritengono che all'azienda spetta ancora molto lavoro.
facts: Wendy's ha respinto un'offerta di acquisizione, secondo MarketWatch
Wendy's ha intenzione di operare in autonomia, secondo MarketWatch
Gli analisti hanno dichiarato che l'azienda ha "un lavoro significativo da fare", secondo MarketWatch
body: MarketWatch ha riportato che Wendy's ha respinto un'offerta di acquisizione.
Secondo MarketWatch, l'azienda intende procedere in autonomia.
Gli analisti hanno dichiarato che l'azienda ha "un lavoro significativo da fare", secondo MarketWatch.
it.context: MarketWatch ha riportato queste informazioni il 12 novembre 2026, dettagliando la transazione aziendale che coinvolge Wendy's.
it.imageCaption: Josh Allen, Arvell Reese e Jahmyr Gibbs hanno offerto prestazioni emozionanti in questa stagione. Composizione: Getty Images

pt.title: Wendy's rejeita proposta de aquisição
pt.dek: A Wendy's planeia prosseguir de forma independente após rejeitar uma oferta de aquisição, e analistas afirmaram que a empresa tem trabalho pela frente.
facts: A Wendy's rejeitou uma oferta de aquisição, segundo a MarketWatch
A Wendy's planeia operar sozinha, segundo a MarketWatch
Analistas afirmaram que a empresa tem "trabalho significativo pela frente", segundo a MarketWatch
body: Wendy's rejeitou uma proposta de aquisição, segundo o MarketWatch.
A empresa planeia prosseguir de forma independente, de acordo com o MarketWatch.
Analistas afirmaram que a empresa tem "trabalho significativo pela frente", segundo o MarketWatch.
pt.context: A MarketWatch reportou a informação a 12 de novembro de 2026, detalhando a transação corporativa envolvendo a Wendy's.
pt.imageCaption: Josh Allen, Arvell Reese e Jahmyr Gibbs produziram performances emocionantes nesta época. Compósito: Getty Images

zh.title: 温蒂汉堡拒绝收购要约
zh.dek: 温蒂汉堡拒绝收购要约后计划独立发展 分析师指出该公司仍有大量工作要做
facts: 据MarketWatch报道温蒂汉堡拒绝了收购要约
据MarketWatch报道温蒂汉堡计划独立运营
据MarketWatch报道分析师表示该公司“仍有重大工作要做”
body: MarketWatch报道温蒂汉堡拒绝了一项收购要约。
据MarketWatch称，该公司计划独立发展。
MarketWatch援引分析师的说法称，该公司“前方有大量工作要做”。
zh.context: MarketWatch于2026年11月12日报道了涉及温蒂汉堡的此次企业交易详情
zh.imageCaption: Josh Allen、Arvell Reese和Jahmyr Gibbs本赛季表现精彩 复合图：Getty Images

ja.title: ウェンディーズ、買収提案を拒否
ja.dek: ウェンディーズは独自の道を進む方針で、アナリストは同社に課題が残ると指摘
facts: ウェンディーズは買収提案を拒否した、とMarketWatch。
ウェンディーズは独自の道を進む方針で、とMarketWatch。
アナリストは同社に「大きな課題が残る」と述べた、とMarketWatch。
body: MarketWatchによると、ウェンディーズは買収提案を拒否した。
同社は独立して事業を進める方針だと、MarketWatchは報じた。
アナリストらは、同社には「重大な課題が待ち受けている」と述べたと、MarketWatchは伝えた。  Wait, I should check if "MarketWatch" should be kept as is. Yes
ja.context: MarketWatchは2026年11月12日に情報を報じ、ウェンディーズの企業取引を詳細に説明した。
ja.imageCaption: 今シーズン、ジョシュ・アレン、アーヴェル・リース、ジャミル・ギブスが躍動的なパフォーマンスを見せた。 composite: Getty Images

problemsFixed: The draft introduces dates (12 November 2026) not present in S2, which only provides the timestamp 2026-11-12T13:05:00.000Z, not a specific announcement date.
The draft mentions Wendy's scaled back breakfast offerings, but S2 does not support this claim; it only mentions the rejection and stock surge.
The draft uses repetitive attribution ('according to MarketWatch') and lacks sentence variation and structural requirements (e.g., opening with actor/number/date).
The headline is not a factual statement of what happened without interpretation (stock surge is a result, not the core event).
